title: Per-environment cost-center billing + pre-paid auto-topup for enterprise accounts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers running multiple environments (dev/staging/prod) currently receive a single pooled billing view and shared entitlements. This causes two pain points: (1) lack of per-environment cost attribution for internal chargebacks and finance reporting, and (2) operational risk when non-production environments exhaust shared credits and cause unexpected overage on production.

Goal: Deliver a system that enables per-environment cost-center tagging, optional per-environment pre-paid credit buckets, and an auto-topup flow that can be configured per-account with invoice/pre-approval controls. The feature should be backward-compatible (defaults to current pooled behavior), provide clear acceptance criteria for billing accuracy, and include a migration path for existing enterprise customers who want to split into environment-level buckets.

Non-goal: Full multi-tenant accounting or general ledger integrations beyond mapping a cost_center tag to invoice lines (that is a future integration).
scope_inclusions: Account-level toggle to enable per-environment billing
API and Console support for tagging callers/routes with environment=dev|staging|prod
Create optional pre-paid credit buckets per environment with configurable thresholds
Auto-topup policy engine: thresholds, topup amount, payment method/invoice pre-approval flag
Invoice line item mapping by cost_center and environment
Billing dashboard filters for environment and cost_center
Backfill/migration tool to split historical usage into environment buckets using caller metadata heuristics
scope_exclusions: Automated GL posting to external finance systems
Enforcement of environment quotas at the runtime kernel level (only soft accounting and alerts for this scope)
Support for more than three environments in initial rollout (dev/staging/prod only)
requirements: Console: Admin can enable 'Per-environment billing' at org level and configure default behavior
API: New field on create-caller and update-caller to set environment and cost_center tags
Billing: Model changes to record usage rows with environment and cost_center columns
Topup: Payment flow to support 'auto-topup' with options: immediate charge, invoice-pre-approval required, or manual approval
Notification: Alerts when an environment's prepaid bucket falls below threshold and when topup is attempted/fails
Reporting: Invoices must include environment and cost_center as separate line-item metadata for chargeback
Migration: Provide an opt-in backfill job that uses recent caller_tag history to populate environment for prior usage with confidence scores
acceptance_criteria: When Per-environment billing is off, current billing/export formats remain unchanged (backwards compatible)
When enabled, invoices produced for a 30-day cycle include environment and cost_center columns and line items where pre-paid buckets were consumed

Automated topup: Given a prepaid bucket configured to auto-topup at 10% threshold with topup amount $5k, when consumption drops below threshold the system creates a topup transaction and marks invoice_preapproval=false for immediate charge; transaction must appear in billing ledger within 90 seconds

Invoice pre-approval: For accounts with invoice_preapproval=true, a topup request creates a 'topup_pending' record and does NOT alter prepaid balance until finance approves via Console; approval flow must be auditable with who/when

Chargeback accuracy: Sampling test — for 10,000 tokens consumed across prod/dev/staging callers, exported CSV must correctly attribute >= 99.9% of tokens to the environment based on caller metadata; any ambiguous rows flagged with confidence=low and assigned to 'unattributed' bucket

Migration: Running the backfill tool on a sandbox org should produce assignment of >= 95% of historical usage to env tags for orgs that followed caller tagging best practices; backfill must produce a dry-run CSV and an idempotent apply step
UI/UX: Console shows per-environment prepaid balance, last topup event, and a one-click 'split existing credits' CTA for admins (visual check by PM and design)
edge_cases_and_tradeoffs: Customers with poor caller tagging will see significant 'unattributed' usage — tradeoff: we provide heuristics (IP ranges, recent caller names) but accuracy varies
Enforcing strict isolation would require runtime changes and be out of scope; we accept soft isolation via reporting and auto-topup for now
Auto-topup failures must never silently reduce available production credits; default behavior on payment failure is to leave balances unchanged and escalate to a SE/CS workflow
migration_plan: Phase 1 (opt-in sandbox): Build backfill dry-run tool + Console UI for admins to review mapping CSV
Phase 2 (pilot): Run backfill and create environment buckets for 3 pilot enterprise customers; collect discrepancies and adjust heuristics
Phase 3: General availability with migration guide; provide API for programmatic approval of pre-approved topups
Data retention: Keep original un-split usage rows for 90 days to allow queries against raw footprint
rollout_plan: Beta for paid enterprise orgs (limited to 5 customers) - Q2 2025
Enable feature-flagged Console controls and API fields behind org-level opt-in
Collect telemetry on tagging coverage and topup success rate during beta
GA after 4 weeks of stable pilot performance or when billing accuracy goals are met (>=99.9% attribution in sampling)
Communications: Customer-facing documentation, migration playbook, and sample scripts for backfill
qa_and_test_plan: Unit tests for new billing model columns and export formatting
Integration test that runs a simulated workload across dev/staging/prod callers and validates invoices contain proper line items
E2E test for auto-topup happy path and payment-failure path with stubbed payment provider
Migration dry-run tests with synthetic caller metadata to validate heuristics
security_and_compliance_notes: Topup invoice_preapproval flag must be visible in audit logs and cannot be changed by non-admins
Prepaid balances are financial data — limit access via role RBAC and ensure KMS-backed encryption for ledger exports
